preferred_delivery: Complete identical common-source notice in both descriptions; no new resource in minimum candidate
construction_notice: request_json is a String containing exactly one JSON object, not an object argument or double-encoded JSON string. Inner shape is exactly {"start_date":S,"end_date":E,"products":P,"user_domain":"captured_users","transitions":"within_request_days"}. S/E are String canonical Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD dates in years0001..9999; start<=end, both inclusive,1..366 natural days. No BC, wide years or infinity. P is exactly {"mode":"all"} or {"mode":"subset","values":[string,...]}; subset has1..64 unique nonempty raw UTF-8 strings, each decoded value <=256 bytes. Preserve case, Unicode and control characters via JSON escaping; no trim, case fold or normalization. This Agent requires subset values already ascending by raw UTF-8 bytes; native accepts arbitrary order and sorts subset order while preserving each decoded string. Exact fields, no missing/default/unknown/duplicate keys or null/number/boolean values; original inner JSON <=16384 UTF-8 bytes including whitespace/escaping. concept is a separate outer String: use the actual qualification_concept discovered from state-program, not User or root observation concept. Both query and compile use this identical request grammar. Date bounds define the emitted calendar and contributing observations; products filter contributing observations. Neither narrows the User domain, which remains all distinct Users of the full frozen capture. Any TRUE wins; nonempty all FALSE is FALSE; missing/all NULL/FALSE+NULL is UNKNOWN, with no carry. On query execution, return every User/day and every within-request adjacent natural-day comparison, including unchanged; changed means different state labels, including changes involving UNKNOWN. Totals count User/day, changed counts User/adjacent-day pairs, not unique changed Users or observation rows. Combined states+comparisons <=10000, full internal JSON <=1048576 bytes including metadata/escaping, refusal without paging/truncation. Query executes/computes; compile binds/explains without computing execution states/comparisons/counts; both tools enforce the metadata-based captured_User_count*(2*days-1)<=10000 gate at binding. Dedicated state contract takes precedence over generic sparse-observation descriptions. Native MCP may ignore unknown outer arguments/coerce values; this Agent sends exactly concept and request_json Strings. Read-only state tools, no import/reload/arbitrary SQL or historical-rule inference.
generic_example_notice: Assumed other frozen daily-observation program declares this exact qualification concept/rule. Current pilot does not declare it; do not execute these outer parameters against pilot. No input rows, state outputs, counts or answers supplied.
limitations: Schema checks date lexical form, not calendar validity, ordering or366-day limit
Raw duplicate keys/original UTF8 budget require strict parsing before decoded schema
Decoded string UTF8 bytes/surrogate validity/raw sorting and actual concept binding require separate checks
Captured user cardinality and full result encoded bytes require native capture/execute checks
No generic observations contract or history date/request shape substitution
